what_this_proves: The complete autonomous loop, running through the real NEMESIS trace lifecycle with a real paid Telegraph call: a dormant branch is rechecked, movement is verified over public Ethereum JSON-RPC, tracing resumes, enrichment is published as case events, one event settles a real x402 payment, and both the answer and the refusal are persisted as receipts on the case timeline.
honesty_note: The movement feed is a controlled path. A dormant branch was seeded at an address whose next outgoing transaction is already known, so the run does not wait on a thief. Nothing else is simulated: NEMESIS fetched and normalized that transaction over RPC itself, and the Telegraph call was routed, paid, and settled for real. This is not presented as organic production activity.

steps.note: Verified before any spend was permitted.
No human action. The dormant branch was rechecked and movement found.
Deterministic tracing resumed from persisted state before Telegraph was contacted.
One event per intent, published rather than awaited.

receipts.note: The per-case-event ceiling was deliberately set to 0.01 for this run. The guard refused the second call before signing, and the refusal is persisted as a visible receipt rather than silently dropped.

branch_state_after_enrichment.note: Branch state is decided by RPC-verified tracing alone. Neither the paid answer nor the refused call changed it.

findings: Three settled routed calls have now returned three different miners: ChainSight (302), SarzOps (91001), and INTERLOCK. Rank at the time of the audit predicted none of them. Reading miner identity from the response, rather than from a cached leaderboard, is confirmed as necessary.
End-to-end latency rose to 14.7 s on this call against 8.9 s and 8.7 s earlier. The 45 s gateway timeout and the decision to keep enrichment off the trace critical path both hold up.

This run exposed a labelling bug. summarize() marked a successful transaction lookup as NO_EXTERNAL_SIGNAL because the reply carried facts but no verdict field. That reads as an absence of information when the miner had in fact answered. It is now intent-aware: only a risk question may be summarized as an absence of risk signal, and an unknown intent still defaults to the cautious reading.
evidence_boundary: Real Telegraph-routed and settled call. NEMESIS JSON-RPC remains authoritative for every blockchain fact on the case.
